alternatives_rejected.why: Its own span self-time is flat at 0.01 ms (1.17x). CPU saturation would slow its own processing; only inbound, caller-observed latency rose, by 84x (E2).

The largest deviation is productcatalogservice_latency-90 (z=955), well above frontend_latency-50 (z=568) (E1). Callers of productcatalogservice see roughly 200 ms added on those calls (E2), so frontend latency looks like a downstream symptom.
Its latency deviation (z=463) is smaller than productcatalogservice's (E1). The added latency is localized to inbound calls to productcatalogservice (E2), and recommendationservice depends on it.

proposed_fix.description: Inspect productcatalogservice's pod network for injected latency (e.g. tc netem qdisc or chaos experiment) and remove it. Then confirm that productcatalogservice inbound p50 returns to about 2 ms and that frontend latency recovers.
